facets.description: topic_embed.rb line 13: the 'Imported from' footer puts the URL into the href and link text without escaping. Because the post is stored as raw_html and rendered with raw, this is an XSS/attribute-breakout hole.
Imported feed/page HTML is stored as raw_html without sanitization, and Post#cook returns it unchanged, so external content is rendered as live HTML.
poll_feed.rb line 35: CGI.unescapeHTML decodes entity-escaped feed content back into live HTML tags.
